Rules
One active tab at a time
Tabs follow radio logic, not checkbox logic.
Text weight doesn’t change
Medium in every state. Otherwise the active tab widens and the others shift.
Mobilda Width=Fill
2–4 tabs fill the full width of the screen. With more than 5, use horizontal scroll.
Keep tab names short
1–2 words. A long name belongs in a side menu, not in Tabs.
Don’t add the content panel to the component
The panel is different every time. Tabs provide navigation only.
Segmented is for 2–3 options only
For more, use Underline or Pill.
